USE [POC_test]
GO

DECLARE @RC int
DECLARE @SourceConnectionName nvarchar(200)
DECLARE @TableName nvarchar(200)
DECLARE @PrimaryKey nvarchar(200)
DECLARE @ColumnList nvarchar(max)
DECLARE @ColumnTypeList nvarchar(max)
DECLARE @WatermarkTS datetime
DECLARE @DetectDeletes int

-- TODO: Set parameter values here.

EXECUTE @RC = [Bronze].[usp_load_cetas_partition] 
 @SourceConnectionName = 'contoso'
  ,@TableName = 'customer'
  ,@PrimaryKey = 'CustomerKey'
  ,@ColumnList = N'[CustomerKey]
      ,[GeoAreaKey]
      ,[StartDT]
      ,[EndDT]
      ,[Continent]
      ,[Gender]
      ,[Title]
      ,[GivenName]
      ,[MiddleInitial]
      ,[Surname]
      ,[StreetAddress]
      ,[City]
      ,[State]
      ,[StateFull]
      ,[ZipCode]
      ,[Country]
      ,[CountryFull]
      ,[Birthday]
      ,[Age]
      ,[Occupation]
      ,[Company]
      ,[Vehicle]
      ,[Latitude]
      ,[Longitude]'
  ,@ColumnTypeList = N'    CAST([CustomerKey] AS INT) AS CustomerKey,
    CAST([GeoAreaKey] AS INT) AS GeoAreaKey,
    CAST([StartDT] AS DATETIME2(7)) AS StartDT,
    CAST([EndDT] AS DATETIME2(7)) AS EndDT,
    CAST([Continent] AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS Continent,
    CAST([Gender] AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS Gender,
    CAST([Title] AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS Title,
    CAST([GivenName] AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS GivenName,
    CAST([MiddleInitial] AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS MiddleInitial,
    CAST([Surname] AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS Surname,
    CAST([StreetAddress] AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS StreetAddress,
    CAST([City] AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS City,
    CAST([State] AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS State,
    CAST([StateFull] AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS StateFull,
    CAST([ZipCode] AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS ZipCode,
    CAST([Country] AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS Country,
    CAST([CountryFull] AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS CountryFull,
    CAST([Birthday] AS DATETIME2(7)) AS Birthday,
    CAST([Age] AS INT) AS Age,
    CAST([Occupation] AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS Occupation,
    CAST([Company] AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS Company,
    CAST([Vehicle] AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS Vehicle,
    CAST([Latitude] AS NUMERIC(20,5)) AS Latitude,
    CAST([Longitude] AS NUMERIC(20,5)) AS Longitude'
  ,@WatermarkTS = '2026-02-02 00:00:00'
  ,@DetectDeletes = 1
GO
